name: Phase Manager
description: Determines the current phase per task type based on training example count and confidence scores. Phase 1→2 transition: when training example count >= phase1_to_phase2 threshold AND a local model is available. Phase 2→3 transition: when rolling correlation >= phase2_to_phase3 threshold over a sustained period (consecutive_windows_above_threshold >= sustained_window_count). Phase 3→2 regression: when correlation drops below coaching_trigger. Phase 3→1 emergency: when correlation drops below emergency_threshold, revert to full remote serving. Emergency threshold also applies to phase 2 (2→1) for safety. Transitions are logged as structured JSON audit events via stdlib logging. Phase is derived (computed from snapshot state), not stored as a discrete flag — emergent from confidence scores. Initial phase at startup is always REMOTE_ONLY (Phase 1). The PhaseManager is a lightweight, near-stateless class initialized with PhaseThresholds and a logging.Logger. Its primary method evaluate() is a pure function with no side effects beyond audit logging.

types.name: Phase
types.description: IntEnum representing the three operational phases. Phase is emergent from confidence scores, not a manually triggered state. REMOTE_ONLY=1: all queries served by remote API. COACHING=2: local model serves queries with remote comparison sampling. AUTONOMOUS=3: local model serves queries independently with periodic spot-checks.

types.name: TransitionReason
types.description: StrEnum categorizing why a phase transition occurred. Used in audit log entries for machine-readable traceability.

types.name: TrendDirection
types.description: Direction of the correlation trend over recent windows, as determined by the confidence engine.

types.name: PhaseThresholds

fields.name: phase1_to_phase2_example_count
fields.description: Minimum number of training examples required to transition from Phase 1 (REMOTE_ONLY) to Phase 2 (COACHING). Must be >= 1.

fields.name: phase2_to_phase3_threshold
fields.description: Minimum rolling correlation score required for Phase 2→3 transition. Must be in (0.0, 1.0].

fields.name: coaching_trigger
fields.description: Correlation threshold below which Phase 3 regresses to Phase 2. Must be in (0.0, 1.0) and less than phase2_to_phase3_threshold.

fields.name: emergency_threshold
fields.description: Correlation threshold below which any phase (2 or 3) emergency-reverts to Phase 1 (REMOTE_ONLY). Must be in [0.0, 1.0) and less than coaching_trigger.

fields.name: sustained_window_count
fields.description: Number of consecutive windows that must exceed phase2_to_phase3_threshold before the 2→3 transition is allowed. Must be >= 1.

types.description: Pydantic v2 validated configuration model containing all threshold parameters for phase transitions. Validated at config parse time via model_validator to enforce: emergency_threshold < coaching_trigger < phase2_to_phase3. All float thresholds are correlation scores in [0.0, 1.0].

types.name: ConfidenceSnapshot

fields.name: task_type
fields.description: Identifier of the task type this snapshot pertains to.

fields.name: correlation_score
fields.description: Current rolling correlation score between local and remote model outputs, in [0.0, 1.0]. Computed by the confidence engine using task-specific evaluators.

fields.name: training_example_count
fields.description: Total number of training examples accumulated for this task type. Used for Phase 1→2 transition check.

fields.name: sample_count
fields.description: Number of comparison-pair samples currently in the rolling window.

fields.name: consecutive_windows_above_threshold
fields.description: Number of consecutive evaluation windows where correlation_score has been >= phase2_to_phase3_threshold. Tracked by the confidence engine. Used by phase manager to enforce sustained-period requirement for 2→3 transition.

fields.name: trend_direction
fields.description: Direction of the correlation trend over recent evaluation windows.

fields.name: is_stale
fields.description: True if the oldest sample in the window exceeds max_window_age, indicating a coaching sample is overdue.

types.description: Point-in-time snapshot of confidence metrics for a single task, produced by the confidence engine and consumed by the phase manager. Contains all information needed to derive the current phase without the phase manager tracking any history.

types.name: PhaseTransition

fields.name: task_type
fields.description: Task type for which the transition occurred.

fields.name: from_phase
fields.description: Phase before the transition.

fields.name: to_phase
fields.description: Phase after the transition.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Machine-readable reason for the transition.

fields.name: correlation_score
fields.description: Correlation score at the time of transition.

fields.name: training_example_count
fields.description: Training example count at the time of transition.

fields.name: consecutive_windows_above_threshold
fields.description: Consecutive windows above threshold at the time of transition.

fields.name: trend_direction
fields.description: Trend direction at the time of transition.

fields.name: local_model_available
fields.description: Whether a local model was available at the time of transition.

types.description: Audit event representing a phase transition. Logged as a structured JSON record via stdlib logging. Contains all context needed for post-hoc analysis and debugging.

types.name: PhaseResult

fields.name: phase
fields.description: The derived phase based on the current snapshot, thresholds, and local model availability.

fields.name: transition
fields.description: Present only if the derived phase differs from previous_phase. Contains the full audit event for the transition. None if no transition occurred.

types.description: Result of a phase evaluation. Contains the derived phase and an optional transition audit event if a phase change occurred.

types.name: OptionalPhaseTransition
types.description: Optional wrapper for PhaseTransition. None when no phase transition occurred.

functions.name: evaluate
functions.description: Pure function that derives the current phase for a task from its confidence snapshot, previous phase, and local model availability. Compares derived phase against previous_phase to detect transitions. Returns a PhaseResult containing the derived Phase and an optional PhaseTransition audit event. Phase derivation logic: (1) If local_model_available is false AND previous_phase is not REMOTE_ONLY, emergency revert to REMOTE_ONLY with reason LOCAL_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE. (2) If correlation_score < emergency_threshold (applies to phases 2 and 3), revert to REMOTE_ONLY. (3) If in REMOTE_ONLY: promote to COACHING only if training_example_count >= phase1_to_phase2_example_count AND local_model_available is true AND sample_count > 0. (4) If in COACHING: promote to AUTONOMOUS only if correlation_score >= phase2_to_phase3_threshold AND consecutive_windows_above_threshold >= sustained_window_count. (5) If in AUTONOMOUS: regress to COACHING if correlation_score < coaching_trigger (but >= emergency_threshold). (6) If in COACHING: remain in COACHING if correlation_score >= emergency_threshold but < phase2_to_phase3_threshold or sustained period not met. All transitions are logged as structured JSON audit events at INFO level. Emergency and regression transitions are logged at WARNING level.

inputs.name: snapshot
inputs.description: Point-in-time confidence metrics for the task being evaluated.

inputs.name: previous_phase
inputs.description: The phase the task was in prior to this evaluation. At startup, this must be REMOTE_ONLY.

inputs.name: local_model_available
inputs.description: Whether a local model is currently available and operational for this task type. If false, phases 2 and 3 are not reachable.

error_cases.name: invalid_snapshot
error_cases.condition: snapshot fails Pydantic validation (e.g., correlation_score out of [0.0, 1.0], negative counts)

error_cases.name: invalid_previous_phase
error_cases.condition: previous_phase is not a recognized Phase enum member

error_data.detail: previous_phase must be a valid Phase member (REMOTE_ONLY=1, COACHING=2, AUTONOMOUS=3)

preconditions: snapshot must be a valid ConfidenceSnapshot with all fields passing validators
previous_phase must be a valid Phase enum member (REMOTE_ONLY, COACHING, or AUTONOMOUS)
PhaseThresholds must have been validated at initialization time (emergency_threshold < coaching_trigger < phase2_to_phase3_threshold)
postconditions: result.phase is always a valid Phase enum member
If result.transition is not None, then result.transition.from_phase == previous_phase AND result.transition.to_phase == result.phase
If result.transition is None, then result.phase == previous_phase
If local_model_available is false, result.phase is REMOTE_ONLY
If snapshot.correlation_score < emergency_threshold AND previous_phase is COACHING or AUTONOMOUS, result.phase is REMOTE_ONLY
If previous_phase is REMOTE_ONLY AND (training_example_count < phase1_to_phase2_example_count OR local_model_available is false OR sample_count == 0), result.phase is REMOTE_ONLY
If previous_phase is COACHING AND result.phase is AUTONOMOUS, then snapshot.consecutive_windows_above_threshold >= sustained_window_count AND snapshot.correlation_score >= phase2_to_phase3_threshold
If previous_phase is AUTONOMOUS AND snapshot.correlation_score < coaching_trigger AND snapshot.correlation_score >= emergency_threshold, result.phase is COACHING
Phase can only advance one step at a time (REMOTE_ONLY→COACHING, COACHING→AUTONOMOUS) but can regress multiple steps (AUTONOMOUS→REMOTE_ONLY, COACHING→REMOTE_ONLY)
result.transition.reason is never NO_TRANSITION when a transition occurs
side_effects: Logs phase transition audit events via stdlib logging with structured JSON format. Promotions logged at INFO level, regressions and emergency reverts logged at WARNING level.

structured_side_effects.description: Logs PhaseTransition as structured JSON at INFO (promotions) or WARNING (regressions/emergencies) level when a transition occurs. No logging when phase is unchanged.

functions.name: get_initial_phase
functions.description: Returns the initial phase for any task at system startup. Always returns REMOTE_ONLY (Phase 1). This is a static/class-level convenience method encoding the invariant that all tasks begin in REMOTE_ONLY phase.

functions.name: validate_thresholds
functions.description: Validates that PhaseThresholds satisfy the required ordering invariant: emergency_threshold < coaching_trigger < phase2_to_phase3_threshold. Called automatically by PhaseThresholds Pydantic model_validator at parse time, but also exposed for explicit programmatic validation. Fails fast with a clear error message if the invariant is violated, per project config error handling policy.

error_data.detail: Thresholds must satisfy: emergency_threshold < coaching_trigger < phase2_to_phase3_threshold

error_cases.name: invalid_field_values
error_cases.condition: Any individual field fails its range or type validator

preconditions: thresholds must have all required fields populated with values passing individual field validators
postconditions: Returned thresholds satisfy: emergency_threshold < coaching_trigger < phase2_to_phase3_threshold
If validation passes, returned object is identical to input

invariants: Phase is always derived from current state (snapshot + thresholds + local_model_available), never stored as a persistent flag
Threshold ordering is always enforced: emergency_threshold < coaching_trigger < phase2_to_phase3_threshold
Initial phase for any task is always REMOTE_ONLY (Phase 1)
Phase can only advance one step at a time: REMOTE_ONLY→COACHING→AUTONOMOUS
Phase can regress multiple steps in a single evaluation: AUTONOMOUS→REMOTE_ONLY or COACHING→REMOTE_ONLY
Emergency threshold (correlation < emergency_threshold) triggers revert to REMOTE_ONLY from any non-REMOTE_ONLY phase (both COACHING and AUTONOMOUS)
Local model unavailability always results in REMOTE_ONLY phase regardless of correlation scores
Every phase transition produces exactly one PhaseTransition audit event logged via structured JSON logging
No phase transition occurs without a transition reason; NO_TRANSITION is never used as a reason in a PhaseTransition event
The evaluate method is a pure function with respect to phase derivation — given the same inputs, it always produces the same output phase and transition
PhaseManager holds no mutable state between evaluate calls — all history is encoded in the ConfidenceSnapshot provided by the confidence engine
Sustained-period requirement for 2→3 is enforced via consecutive_windows_above_threshold >= sustained_window_count, not by internal state tracking
